name: Newborn vital signs from motion-amplified video

mentions.name: Newborn vital signs from motion-amplified video
mentions.description: An experiment using motion amplification on 4K video of a sleeping newborn to predict heart and respiratory rate, working through algorithms from published papers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Playing with motion amplification to see if we can predict heart/respiratory rate of my newborn. I shot a few 4k videos of him sleeping as test data and working through some algorithms from published papers.

evidence.value: Playing with motion amplification to see if we can predict heart/respiratory rate of my newborn. I shot a few 4k videos of him sleeping as test data and working through some algorithms from published papers.
